  "situation": "An employee of a DOE contractor applied for a security clearance. The Local Security Office raised concerns under Guideline G because the employee had been cited for Minor in Consumption in 2008 and a psychologist evaluated him as a habitual or binge drinker whose consumption impaired judgment. The employee reported current drinking of four to five beers once or twice weekly and occasional intoxication, but testified that he had abstained since early March 2018 and had begun individual therapy, though he had not completed the psychologist’s recommended twelve‑week group program. Witnesses attested to his trustworthiness but did not confirm a long‑term abstinence plan. The psychologist maintained that the employee had not made satisfactory progress and reiterated the need for group therapy or a year of abstinence.",

      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "assessment",
      "status": "assessed",

      "spans": ["src:27662a135d51#p4.3"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "kind": "assessment",
      "status": "assessed",

      "id": "F9",
      "kind": "assessment",
